_comment: Symmetric zero-pi as in circuit-quantization tests/circuits.py zero_pi(): J1 (1->2), J2 (3->4), L1 (2->3), L2 (4->1), C1 (1->3), C2 (2->4), floating; named J1a, J1b, L1a, L1b, C1a, C1b here.
Elements: junction C = ghz_to_farad(E_CJ), EJ = E_J; L = ghz_to_henry(E_L); large C = ghz_to_farad(E_CS*E_CJ/(E_CJ - E_CS)), so that C + C_J has charging energy E_CS (scqubits' ECS).
Z_full columns (theta, phi, zeta, Sigma) = notes eq:zp_Z with theta, phi negated and zeta divided by sqrt(2); Sigma is cyclic (floating circuit).
zeta is a decoupled harmonic mode (scqubits ZeroPi drops it; zero_pi.json has no zeta).

Ring flux on the junctions: custom B with +1/2 of the ring flux on each junction and capacitor entries solving G B = I (static flux: a gauge choice; the irrotational B would put it on L<q>b instead, giving flux_linear on phi and zeta).
subs: x_B -> E_CS*E_CJ/(E_CJ - E_CS), n_g1 -> n_g.
constant 0: scqubits' potential adds 2 E_J (zero_pi.json keeps it).
